verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents several APIs (Alerts, Case, Case import, filing). However, its developer docs are password-gated, and no public versioning scheme or deprecation policy is documented. The only versioning signal is a date-named docs version meta tag on the gate page, which is not a documented API versioning or deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
